My dear [Lady Salisbury](../persons.html#548)

When I was at Oxford in the spring I promised [Canon Bright](../persons.html#199) to ask you whether it was true that some papers had been found at Hatfield which threw some light on the genuineness of the Casket Letters of Queen Mary. I thought I would wait to write to you till the whirl of summer occupation had a little gone by, but one might as well wait for a river to run dry (or better perhaps in such a season as this) So I venture to ask if you will be so kind as to ask your [librarian](../persons.html#600)[^1] to tell me whether there has been any such discovery

I remain

yours truly

C M Yonge

And now I see you are at Dieppe.

However I shall let this pursue you!

[^1]: Richard Thompson Gunton (1846-1921), librarian at Hatfield House 1878-1921.
